trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. Budget for a long road — press estimates put a full platinum run near 200 hours, so treat the roadmap stages as your checklist, not a sprint.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing to the end. It cannot be missed — the trophy pops as the story moves on.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Chapter trophies can pop as the next chapter begins rather than on the final cutscene, so keep playing if it does not appear at once. Before the chapter ends, do Lucia's balcony meditation — see Positive Mental Attitude.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. From here Jason and Lucia are both playable, and you can call your partner in for the duo trophies.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. When Race Against Yago appears in this chapter, do it right away — it is time-sensitive.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Bank vaults open near the end of this chapter through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. Keep one untouched manual save from just before it — there is no mission replay, so a clean save is your only way back.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Unmissable story trophy — it pops as you play.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. Unmissable story trophy — it pops as you play.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Unmissable story trophy — it pops as you play.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Unmissable story trophy — it pops as you play.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. Unmissable story trophy — it pops as you play.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Unmissable story trophy — it pops as you play.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion — the checklist itself only opens after the story, under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion, but work done earlier still counts. Beyond the trophy counters, the known 100% thresholds are 300 stunts, 70 of 80 Challenges, 200 of 277 vehicle models, all 8 bank vaults and all 39 illegal operations. Press estimates put the platinum run near 200 hours.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts — jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count. Keep going past 250: full completion needs 300.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try one of each of the 9 activity types — races, fishing, arcade games, the shooting range, drone races, bowling, meditation, gym training and more. One of each is enough.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the two ranges. Check each challenge's progress in-game and clear the ones you are weakest at last.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. Track which locations are done — the PSN counter reads 0/14.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — repeats of the same race do not count twice. Street races, drone races and other race types all feed the counter.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Doable from Chapter 1, and already earned by a small share of players at launch — an early win.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one arcade game. Doable from Chapter 1.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's questline to its final mission. Andy's strand is Lucia-only. It stays open after the credits, and it does not count toward Strangers & Freaks — it has its own trophy.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's questline to its final mission. It stays open after the credits.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's questline to its final mission. It stays open after the credits and does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.missable_note: Race Against Yago (Chapter 3, Yago's street-racing strand) is time-sensitive — do it the moment it appears.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Not every optional questline counts — Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's have their own trophies and do not count, so check the trophy's progress counter after each strand. Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 is time-sensitive: save first, then race.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's questline to its final mission. It stays open after the credits.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's questline to its final mission. Tyrone's strand is Jason-only. It stays open after the credits and does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missable_note: THE ONLY MISSABLE: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 disappears after Chapter 1. No mission replay, no New Game Plus.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida — they show as purple icons when you are close, and each outdoor spot should count twice if you meditate there with both characters, so bring your partner every time. THE MISSABLE ONE: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 disappears after Chapter 1. After Lucia is home, check the kitchen in the morning — a morning after the mission Down to Earth is the usual time — she heads to the balcony of Jason's house to meditate; follow her and accept the optional task. Keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops. Output Lag notes it is not confirmed the trophy strictly needs the balcony spot, but do it anyway — GTABase and PowerPyx both flag this as the only trophy that may be missable.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret — his questline is Jason-only and sends you after animals through target decks. A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine. It stays open after the credits.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida; track sets in the in-game collection menu.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app. Scanning a vehicle with WAiNK also counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive and the two counters climb together.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges listed under Progress, Challenges. Many complete on their own while you play; full completion needs 70.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With Jason and Lucia together, build a 4-star Wanted Level and escape the heat — the trophy pops only once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area. Bank vault jobs hand you a 4-star level straight away, so escaping one with your partner earns this too.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Call your partner, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you. If the stars fade and only the red heat zone remains, the chain breaks. It can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it — scan traffic as you drive. Full completion needs 200 of the 277 base models.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus — slow-motion aim, press L3 and R3 while aiming. Pick a group of gang enemies, for example guards at an illegal operation, use an assault rifle, and Adrenaline extends Focus.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge — planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count. Gates E3 and E4 work. Get to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off; the pop is delayed until you have flown about 1 km from the airport. Save first — police come fast.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a military tank (Rhino). Tanks should be parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, get in, drive and fire until it pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies. Use the Snap Gun on a store's locked back door — kicking it in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe and leave unseen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target; if spotted, reload.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults open through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4. Tail an armored security van to a large bank and slip into the vault while the guard has it open. You cannot carry all the bags alone — bring your partner. Vault jobs hand you a 4-star Wanted Level straight away, so escaping one with your partner also earns Hot Together. Full completion needs all 8 vaults.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It pops only once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Progress is tracked per area in-game; mop up unvisited areas after the story.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs. Full completion needs all 39 operations, so this pops along the way.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: METHOD UNCONFIRMED AT LAUNCH: no confirmed unlock method — the description is the only hint. Do not trust any guide that names a specific Ocean Beach spot as fact; the trophy likely ties to one, but nothing is confirmed yet. Check back once a method is verified.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: METHOD UNCONFIRMED AT LAUNCH: no confirmed unlock method — the description is the only hint. Do not trust any guide that names a showroom, vehicle or method as fact.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: At Kingpin Bowling — the Kolt & Associates bowling alley, an illegal operation visited in Chapter 2 — bring Sticky Bombs. Take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, blown open with a Sticky Bomb. Then escape the police. Leaving something behind is not fatal: the operation comes back later.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reported, not fully confirmed: this should pop when Jason and Lucia both reach maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner there — the partner trains alongside you. Treat the trigger as reported until it is verified.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind. Warning: PowerPyx and GTABase both say the Irredeemable Criminal Profile state is permanent — read a Criminal Profile guide before a rampage.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: METHOD UNCONFIRMED AT LAUNCH: no confirmed unlock method — the description is the only hint. The description suggests succeeding on a second attempt at something; that is a reading of the description, not a confirmed method.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: METHOD UNCONFIRMED AT LAUNCH: no confirmed unlock method — the description is the only hint. The description suggests witnessing something strange or unexplained; that is a reading of the description, not a confirmed method.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: METHOD UNCONFIRMED AT LAUNCH: the exact trigger is unconfirmed, though the description itself names the act — a melee drive-by knocking someone over. A melee drive-by means striking someone with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle; the precise conditions that pop the trophy are not yet verified.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through contacts, cumulatively. Marked Bills come from bank and payday loan jobs; sell them to contacts to launder them.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops, cumulatively — every kind of shop counts.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, which opens after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000, and garages the story gives you do not count.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the app: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space — buy garages first and register cheap cars.
